SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 2.2.1 Pre- reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Collaboration: learner practices teamwork by recognizing discussions and observing rules of engagement as they observe each other’s

sitting posture and give feedback.

Values:
Responsibility: developed as the learner takes care of the reading materials.

Pertinent Contemporary Issues:

Life skills: enhanced as the learner practises sitting in the appropriate body posture.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Kiswahili Language Activities: as learners read small and capital letters of the alphabet for reading preparedness.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Flash cards/charts, assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips, page-turners, adapted digital

devices

Other Related Service Providers: Resource person, speech therapist, Learner support assistance, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist.
